mapper.sql: SELECT contactUserId, MAX(receivedMessageId) AS lastReceivedMessageId FROM ( SELECT recipientId AS contactUserId, NULL AS receivedMessageId FROM private_message WHERE senderId = #{userId} AND isDelete = 0 UNION ALL SELECT senderId AS contactUserId, id AS receivedMessageId FROM private_message WHERE recipientId = #{userId} AND isDelete = 0 ) directions WHERE contactUserId != #{userId} GROUP BY contactUserId
mapper.select: SELECT contacts.contactUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.userName, ''), '对方用户') AS userName, u.userAvatar, latest.id AS lastMessageId, LEFT(latest.content, 120) AS lastMessageContent, latest.createTime AS lastMessageTime, contacts.lastReceivedMessageId FROM () contacts JOIN private_message latest ON latest.id = ( SELECT m.id FROM private_message m WHERE m.isDelete = 0 AND ( (m.senderId = #{userId} AND m.recipientId = contacts.contactUserId) OR (m.recipientId = #{userId} AND m.senderId = contacts.contactUserId) ) ORDER BY m.createTime DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = contacts.contactUserId AND u.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY latest.createTime DESC, latest.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
